context: Tests whether jooq-persistence loads a parent with its children in one query using MULTISET mapped with Records.mapping, carries the version into the read record, guards the confirm update with the version check and a version increment, reports a stale update to the service instead of throwing or overwriting, marks the OPEN-status condition with the business rule comment, and keeps transactions out of the repository. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.

checklist.name: Repository for the aggregate
checklist.description: A @Repository for the order aggregate (e.g. PurchaseOrderRepository or OrderRepository) with constructor-injected DSLContext; no separate repository for order lines

checklist.name: MULTISET for the lines
checklist.description: The order detail is read in one query with multiset(select ... from ORDER_LINE ... where ... = PURCHASE_ORDER.ID) converted with Records.mapping into a record list; no query per order line

checklist.name: Product name joined
checklist.description: Each line record carries the product name via a join or implicit join to PRODUCT

checklist.name: Version in the read record
checklist.description: The order detail record includes the version so the service can pass it back for the update

checklist.name: Optimistic locking on the update
checklist.description: The confirm update has WHERE id = ? AND version = ?, sets version = version + 1, and returns whether a row was updated (boolean or row count) instead of overwriting silently

checklist.name: BR-001 marker
checklist.description: Where the repository restricts the update to status OPEN, '// UC-020 BR-001: ...' is directly above that condition (or, if the agent leaves the rule to the service, it says so and puts no misleading marker)

checklist.name: No fetchInto and no @Transactional
checklist.description: fetchInto(Dto.class) is not used for projections and the repository carries no @Transactional

checklist.name: Handover
checklist.description: A 'Handover from jooq-persistence (UC-020)' block lists the read and confirm method signatures and the record types, noting that the update reports a stale version; ends with 'Next: /spring-service UC-020'
